Controls: All nonlegacy modes use the same textures, palette, world density and water shader. Alpha uses a broad mask. Detail uses a narrow world-anchored noise-disrupted mask. Multiscale uses the Detail mask with a 3-level undecimated Gaussian/Laplacian material blend. Legacy is the existing flat brush and feathered field.
Execution: Static material cache built on CPU at scene entry, displayed through ordinary Vulkan sprite rendering. Dynamic water fields remain live. No runtime neural inference.
Authority: Path strokes shared with the existing authored path. Bank distance comes from liquid-mask boundary edges. No navigation, collision, wetness, pickups or simulation changes.
Gates: Every matrix run succeeds. All playtest facts except the terrain selector agree with legacy at every step, including full state and field hashes. Gamma, reconstruction, deterministic output and source-mask preservation tests pass.
VisualSelection: Codex compares native full-scene and close-up captures; no independent human preference or realism claim. Cost measured as cold cache time and retained bytes, not a portable per-frame GPU benchmark.
Scope: Farm path and Riverside bank only. Overworld decorative river remains outside the study. The semantic rectangular river shape remains unchanged.
